subject: Linguistics
title: Script Reform
description: A quick win: understand Script Reform.

hook.text: In one year, Turkey went from Arabic to Latin script—and millions had to relearn reading overnight.

buildup.text: Script reforms happen when governments decide a new writing system better serves their goals.

discovery.text: Vietnam switched from Chinese characters to a Latin-based system during French colonial rule.

twist.text: Some reforms fail: multiple attempts to simplify English spelling have been rejected for over 200 years.

climax.text: Script reform is always political—changing letters changes access, identity, and cultural continuity.

punchline.text: Changing a script is changing a nation's face.

quiz.question: Why do script reforms often face resistance?
options: They affect identity and cultural continuity
